featured_reviews.review_text:
Gluttony!
An amazing bakery in marol which serves really high quality cakes and stuff. They use the finest ingredients and methods. I recently had a few stuff from gluttony and I'm not gonna lie they were top notch! Talking bout the packing, it was packed really well nothing was smashed or ruined ,it was delivered safely and in time. In the wake of the virus too they are delivering amazing cakes and stuff and it's well taken care of. All safety measures are taken and in the entire process there is no compromise with the taste whatsoever. It really is an amazing place!

What I had ordered :-

• Blueberry Cheesecake (mini)
One of the finest cheesecakes I've ever had. It was just smooth and very finely made. Truly loved the taste. *Highly recommended*

• Chocolate Ganache Pastry
It was really good. Tasted heavenly. Well packed and totally worth the pay. The chocolate that was used was really good.

• Chocolate Mousse
It was really smooth and well prepared. The taste was really good and I totally enjoyed it.

Overall, it was an amazing experience with gluttony. Totally recommended to you guys! They serve amazing cakes and other stuff too. Would love to order again!💓

featured_reviews.name: Roxanne Gonsalves
featured_reviews.review_text:
I honestly cannot believe how terrible my experience with Theobroma has been. Their customer service is beyond unacceptable. I placed an order well in advance, gave clear instructions, and expected basic professionalism — but apparently that’s too much for them.

They kept delaying, giving excuse after excuse, and still couldn’t manage to make the simple cake I requested. Every time I followed up, I got vague answers and zero responsibility. And then, as if the incompetence wasn’t enough, they had the nerve to cancel my order at the absolute last minute.

Who does that?

This was for an important occasion, and they left me scrambling with no time to fix their mess. The sheer lack of organisation, accountability, and respect for customers is unbelievable. For a brand that pretends to be “premium,” their behaviour is anything but.

If I could give zero stars — or honestly, negative stars — Theobroma would earn them without a second thought. One star is the absolute minimum this platform allows, and even that feels far too generous for what they put us through.

This review is about a previous incident that still makes my blood boil. We placed a cake order an entire week in advance — more than enough time for any competent bakery to prepare. But on the actual day, Theobroma simply did not make the cake at all. And the reason? They forgot. Yes, they literally forgot to make a pre-scheduled cake order.

No update, no warning, no apology — nothing. Just silence and complete negligence.

This wasn’t a small mistake — it was a complete failure, and it shows just how little they value their customers.
